guardsAndEvidence.guard: _unzip_iter: NO entry-name filtering, NO containment (CWE-22 primary - hand-rolled zip-slip)
guardsAndEvidence.evidence: downloader.py:2249-:2300: namelist entries are split on '/' and joined onto root with os.path.join(root, *pieces) (:2281) and os.path.join(root, *filename.split('/')) (:2287). os.path.join keeps '..' segments lexically (they resolve at the mkdir/open syscalls) and an ABSOLUTE entry name (e.g. 'C:/x' or '/etc/x') REPLACES root entirely. There is no filter=, no member allowlist, no '..' rejection, no prefix/startswith check, no resolve/realpath anywhere in the loop. The zip is the package downloaded from the data server (:717/:718), so entry names are data-server-controlled (server URL is operator-configurable: DEFAULT_URL, NLTK_DOWNLOAD_URL :2568, or the interactive 'New URL>' :1284).
